reason: The hypothesis combines the known idea of using precipitates for ductility (from boride studies) with the known Cr-V precipitation in W-based RHEAs under irradiation, but applies it to a new alloy (NbMoTaW) with a new element (Cr) and a new dual purpose (room-temperature ductility plus irradiation tolerance), which no passage proposes. The mechanism linking Cr-rich grain-boundary precipitates to both crack arrest and defect sinking in NbMoTaW is not stated in any passage.
